1f03de4b853d.speaker: ray
1f03de4b853d.text: Room 214. The coffee's still bad, and Danny's still in the middle of the board.

453d5cd57f2c.speaker: ray
453d5cd57f2c.text: Quarter past midnight. The squad room is mine again.

429ec3f4868d.speaker: ray
429ec3f4868d.text: Danny Reyes. Two nights cold, and the lieutenant wants it closed by Friday.

1c61912ca76f.speaker: ray
1c61912ca76f.text: First, the file. I locked it away like a careful man.

5e348cced2a6.speaker: ray
5e348cced2a6.text: Then I hid the key like a paranoid one.

35ccb80a63c8.speaker: ray
35ccb80a63c8.text: The door's not locked. My problems are.

e50f45004811.speaker: ray
e50f45004811.text: Not yet. Danny's waiting on the board.

e51bbc49f05e.speaker: ray
e51bbc49f05e.text: Let's go see what the Blue Note didn't see.

ddd7e03905ae.speaker: ray
ddd7e03905ae.text: My raincoat. Twenty years old and it still leaks at the collar.

2c90610bf78d.speaker: ray
2c90610bf78d.text: It's raining out. I'll be wet either way.

78179ea5932d.speaker: ray
78179ea5932d.text: Danny's in the middle. Everything I know is on that board, and it isn't enough.

221b6aed00ea.speaker: ray
221b6aed00ea.text: Danny, the envelope, and a question mark. It's a start.

7820ea2db3d6.speaker: ray
7820ea2db3d6.text: Pinning that up won't solve anything.

522ec13b7632.speaker: ray
522ec13b7632.text: The murder board. Every case up there has a name. Most have a face.

6614ee83f0b8.speaker: ray
6614ee83f0b8.text: Reyes is the one in the middle. String leads to the Blue Note.

79a671c44c6c.speaker: ray
79a671c44c6c.text: Green banker's lamp. Older than half the squad.

d31fc009b212.speaker: ray
d31fc009b212.text: The base sits a little crooked.

d2f6b273bbd7.speaker: ray
d2f6b273bbd7.text: Old habit. Tape a key under the lamp base, where nobody looks.

8d63c8ca03b4.speaker: ray
8d63c8ca03b4.text: Nothing else under there but dust.

e9e8bef71f4a.speaker: ray
e9e8bef71f4a.text: Department computer. It takes four passwords to tell me nothing.

1570bfeee9cb.speaker: ray
1570bfeee9cb.text: Reyes, Daniel. No priors, no warrants, no next of kin who'll pick up.

21295a014d24.speaker: ray
21295a014d24.text: The report can wait. The report can always wait.

81a65eb47937.speaker: ray
81a65eb47937.text: The desk phone. It only rings when someone's dead.

5f7c60bcd81b.speaker: ray
5f7c60bcd81b.text: Not until I know what I'm telling her.

c77350b14797.speaker: ray
c77350b14797.text: Nobody I want to call at this hour.

19ee29b6365b.speaker: ray
19ee29b6365b.text: My coffee. Made at six. It's past midnight now.

a340a03cb276.speaker: ray
a340a03cb276.text: My desk. Government issue, scarred by three chiefs and a budget freeze.

c2293fce2a6d.speaker: ray
c2293fce2a6d.text: Old reports and older sandwiches. Nothing for Reyes.

c97a68d8a411.speaker: ray
c97a68d8a411.text: Down the hatch. Somebody else's hatch.

cc60ec9da188.speaker: ray
cc60ec9da188.text: Well. There's a dime at the bottom of the mug.

bd9a2c6f952a.speaker: ray
bd9a2c6f952a.text: The wastebasket. Where most of my theories end up.

84f2c2341186.speaker: ray
84f2c2341186.text: I'm not digging through that again.

7fe80f184643.speaker: ray
7fe80f184643.text: I should read it before I go anywhere. Right-click it in the inventory.

340f5b515ff3.speaker: ray
340f5b515ff3.text: Open files and closed cases. Should be the other way around.

62140af7456a.speaker: ray
62140af7456a.text: The filing cabinet. Locked. I keep the key somewhere clever.

6d39dbd64dab.speaker: ray
6d39dbd64dab.text: I've got what I need from it.

7e386c8a44e1.speaker: ray
7e386c8a44e1.text: Locked. I'm the one who locked it, too.

529ebab255c1.speaker: ray
529ebab255c1.text: Four million people out there. One of them killed Danny Reyes.

5d85dd605ab5.speaker: ray
5d85dd605ab5.text: Painted shut. The blinds are the only thing in here that opens.

3a1a9ca267d9.speaker: ray
3a1a9ca267d9.text: One twenty-five. The city's second shift is half over and I've got one envelope to show for it.

21b2b23c44d3.speaker: ray
21b2b23c44d3.text: It clanks all night, like a drunk in the cells.

03ed99b25a46.speaker: ray
03ed99b25a46.text: Hot enough to brand a man. I'll pass.

7ced0218740d.speaker: ray
7ced0218740d.text: Reheating it won't make it coffee.

e1cc7cbacccf.speaker: ray
e1cc7cbacccf.text: The squad's coffee machine. It makes something brown and hot. Usually.

a1e25cdbcc67.speaker: ray
a1e25cdbcc67.text: Out of filters since March. Nobody's filed the requisition.

04f87ff4c9a4.speaker: ray
04f87ff4c9a4.text: My cell is in my coat. My coat is wet. We all have problems.

637afde9b802.speaker: ray
637afde9b802.text: Let me go over the file once more.

8865ee514673.speaker: ray
8865ee514673.text: Two nights, one bullet, one piano player. Why?

76533bd2572f.speaker: ray
76533bd2572f.text: Vance doesn't shoot paying customers, and Danny had paid.

e71f1a8080df.speaker: ray
e71f1a8080df.text: I haven't proved that. Doyle would love it if I had.

c276ae66ac59.speaker: ray
c276ae66ac59.text: A robber who leaves the wallet. Worst robber in Hollywood.

28690ae504e9.speaker: ray
28690ae504e9.text: Not what he owed. What he had.

306a8a6f51ff.speaker: ray
306a8a6f51ff.text: Think, Ray. What did the killer leave behind, and what did he take? And who still owed Danny?

a7efee4d3955.speaker: ray
a7efee4d3955.text: Danny wasn't killed for what he owed. He was killed for what he had.

6b06dc3662d0.speaker: ray
6b06dc3662d0.text: Somebody paid a broke piano player eight grand and promised two more. Then they stopped paying.

5ac705191906.speaker: ray
5ac705191906.text: Case stays open. I should tell the lieutenant. She'll want to hear it's not closed.

46eccbe0a008.speaker: ray
46eccbe0a008.text: It's Kessler. Reyes isn't a debt killing.

660d1bcc4d3a.speaker: ray
660d1bcc4d3a.text: Danny paid Vance off in full the afternoon he died. Eight thousand, cash.

533c64e64530.speaker: ray
533c64e64530.text: Vance was on his boat on Catalina.

a790ff852cfe.speaker: ray
a790ff852cfe.text: He talks through his door if you knock right. Danny's knock. His girl, Nina, gave it to me.

c78c1f1b6706.speaker: ray
c78c1f1b6706.text: It's a motive. Somebody gave a broke man eight grand, and he was expecting more.

b00082f79240.speaker: ray
b00082f79240.text: Wasting the night. That's what nights are for.

5b9dbb8d14e2.speaker: ray
5b9dbb8d14e2.text: I've got a coat. It leaks.

2e8a94598442.speaker: ray
2e8a94598442.text: That says he had money. What says there was more coming, and what the killer wanted instead?

e645cf3c9435.speaker: ray
e645cf3c9435.text: The gun tells me how. I need why.

d16213b60863.speaker: ray
d16213b60863.text: That clears Vance. It doesn't tell me why Danny died.

a26ee00798ba.speaker: ray
a26ee00798ba.text: That's how I got through a door, not why he's dead.

d8862493f7a0.speaker: ray
d8862493f7a0.text: That's where I went, not what I found.

7c42f745aaa5.speaker: ray
7c42f745aaa5.text: A phone number. Nina's, it turns out. Not a motive.

0807fcea05dc.speaker: ray
0807fcea05dc.text: The Blue Note's across the street. Lights are off, but somebody's home.

d31398df1a88.speaker: ray
d31398df1a88.text: The precinct. Coffee's worse than the company.

761d3bbeff52.speaker: ray
761d3bbeff52.text: The Blue Note. Door's locked. The light inside says somebody's home.

ba010ac13ba9.speaker: ray
ba010ac13ba9.text: Sal's said all he's going to say.

a65163ddc067.speaker: ray
a65163ddc067.text: Nothing. Whoever's in there isn't expecting company. Not my kind.

d3eb8cd958d6.speaker: ray
d3eb8cd958d6.text: BLUE NOTE. Live jazz Thursdays. Dead piano player Tuesday.

db221fa79a15.speaker: ray
db221fa79a15.text: NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING. Zone change, 6400 block. Applicant: Pryce Development.

5344c6b7ad62.speaker: ray
5344c6b7ad62.text: Somebody wants to build something. In this town somebody always does.

5dcbf5a01f1e.speaker: ray
5dcbf5a01f1e.text: A dime's no good without a number to call.

ed7b6ef82ac6.speaker: ray
ed7b6ef82ac6.text: The last payphone in Hollywood. Somebody keeps paying the bill on it, and I'd like to know why.

e4e1e9f89aa2.speaker: ray
e4e1e9f89aa2.text: A payphone. Ten cents buys you thirty seconds of somebody's attention.

aec72a159f95.speaker: ray
aec72a159f95.text: Dial tone. It wants a dime.

6883f7e26950.speaker: ray
6883f7e26950.text: There's always loose change back in the squad room. Usually at the bottom of something.

3e490c282f8e.speaker: ray
3e490c282f8e.text: A dumpster at the mouth of the alley, where they found Danny.

3ece56c8d6fa.speaker: ray
3ece56c8d6fa.text: Something blue is caught under the lid.

70f9162acf25.speaker: ray
70f9162acf25.text: A matchbook from the Blue Note. Wet, but readable.

9b6060d43adb.speaker: ray
9b6060d43adb.text: There's a phone number written inside. In a hurry.

d8e5dd6f6795.speaker: ray
d8e5dd6f6795.text: Just garbage now. The uniforms missed the good stuff.

c6ee3cbad4c0.speaker: ray
c6ee3cbad4c0.text: Where Danny Reyes stopped being a piano player and started being a case.

7683c94ad0eb.speaker: ray
7683c94ad0eb.text: Sodium light. Makes everybody look guilty. Saves time.

8f57ad93776f.speaker: ray
8f57ad93776f.text: My car. Unmarked, if you don't count the dents.

7c226b5299a5.speaker: ray
7c226b5299a5.text: Not leaving until I've talked to Sal.

3cf91f7b9b1d.speaker: ray
3cf91f7b9b1d.text: Pier 9. San Pedro. Forty minutes if the 110 behaves.

64809b0765a2.speaker: ray
64809b0765a2.text: SUNSET INJURY LAW. In this town even the lawyers work the night shift.

b8ec0bc3d991.speaker: ray
b8ec0bc3d991.text: POLICE. They put it in big letters in case anyone forgets.

5a07a9c198cb.speaker: ray
5a07a9c198cb.text: Lights on, chairs up, one silhouette at the bar. Closed, they'd tell you.

762a06663a50.speaker: ray
762a06663a50.text: Tapping on the glass gets you a look, not an answer.

6a5d3e9edb36.speaker: ray
6a5d3e9edb36.text: There goes my dime. I'll need another one.

09cbe9d54718.speaker: ray
09cbe9d54718.text: ...Actually, I won't. I'm not paying twice for that kind of manners.

41d90b35a638.speaker: ray
41d90b35a638.text: I'm sorry, Nina. Ray Kessler. I work Homicide.

e29a2f03e5c1.speaker: ray
e29a2f03e5c1.text: How do I get Sal to open the door?

614f196711da.speaker: ray
614f196711da.text: Two slow, three fast. Like a piano man.

df647dbdd7b7.speaker: ray
df647dbdd7b7.text: The phone coughs my dime back up. Small mercies.

9fff9f24c48c.speaker: ray
9fff9f24c48c.text: Did you see who shot him?

484f5a41b52a.speaker: ray
484f5a41b52a.text: You told the uniforms you didn't hear anything.

8c6e3618df86.speaker: ray
8c6e3618df86.text: Who did Danny owe money to?

016a287ce3ab.speaker: ray
016a287ce3ab.text: Sal saw something after all. They always do.

000fe765531b.speaker: ray
000fe765531b.text: The 110 at one in the morning. Trucks, cabs, and people who don't want to go home.

b2b828cbed01.speaker: ray
b2b828cbed01.text: She's got her mother's timing. And my hours.

65c46266ea8a.speaker: ray
65c46266ea8a.text: Pier 9. The ocean smells like diesel and money.

1425a989ad06.speaker: ray
1425a989ad06.text: Green door. And a man the size of the door in front of it.

667cc8944b7e.speaker: ray
667cc8944b7e.text: Tiny burns the trash every night. Lucky for me it rains every night too.

d8604d137016.speaker: ray
d8604d137016.text: A steel door, painted green a long time ago. Sal was right.

7f796adb4f95.speaker: ray
7f796adb4f95.text: A transistor radio. Somebody's playing Monk. Danny played it better, I'd bet.

f11cc5724878.speaker: ray
f11cc5724878.text: Not my radio. Not my music, either, these days.

ccd35de3add4.speaker: ray
ccd35de3add4.text: A burn barrel. The rain's winning; it only smolders.

b2870e26b15e.speaker: ray
b2870e26b15e.text: Nothing in there I want. Yet.

8be9ee4e6529.speaker: ray
8be9ee4e6529.text: Nothing else in there but fish heads.

ca327751ed00.speaker: ray
ca327751ed00.text: Warming my hands over Vance's garbage isn't detective work.

ddb571e9c02b.speaker: ray
ddb571e9c02b.text: Wet ash, fish heads, and whatever Tiny had for dinner. Not with my hand.

fa5ecdc3bf33.speaker: ray
fa5ecdc3bf33.text: A boat hook hung on a piling. Every pier has one, and they're never where they belong.

4c21ee6e601b.speaker: ray
4c21ee6e601b.text: A piling with a nail in it. The boat hook's with me.

ba13e0f831ed.speaker: ray
ba13e0f831ed.text: Forty-foot boxes from Busan and Shenzhen. Anything can be in them, and usually is.

4eb0a8db44b6.speaker: ray
4eb0a8db44b6.text: A gantry crane, blinking red at the top like it's got somewhere to be.

8d4c174800a6.speaker: ray
8d4c174800a6.text: HARBOR MARINE SALVAGE. They salvage people, mostly.

3a461cc0a65f.speaker: ray
3a461cc0a65f.text: I might need that. The harbor doesn't.

729a0f64caa7.speaker: ray
729a0f64caa7.text: Black water. Whatever goes in here doesn't come back up. Not in this harbor.

4c359cdc9992.speaker: ray
4c359cdc9992.text: Still dented. Now wet and dented.

33b7d79c1188.speaker: ray
33b7d79c1188.text: Not until I've talked to Vance.

e4d3ce6b86d1.speaker: ray
e4d3ce6b86d1.text: Back to the board. Danny's got a new piece of paper on it.

5e903b042a7f.speaker: ray
5e903b042a7f.text: Six-five, maybe more. Built like a vending machine.

72fdb9104c6d.speaker: ray
72fdb9104c6d.text: There's a Blue Note cocktail napkin folded in his breast pocket.

7d78c07c4a64.speaker: ray
7d78c07c4a64.text: He's seen it. Once was enough.

893f2353888b.speaker: ray
893f2353888b.text: He's not going to read it.

4797ba439ed8.speaker: ray
4797ba439ed8.text: Tiny doesn't look like a man who takes tips.

cf674d84123c.speaker: ray
cf674d84123c.text: Five minutes, he said. Tiny looks like a man who counts.

d6abd52363c3.speaker: ray
d6abd52363c3.text: You drink at the Blue Note.

51ed491adee1.speaker: ray
51ed491adee1.text: People who've been here before. People who knock like they've been here before.

80f0c0ada39c.speaker: ray
80f0c0ada39c.text: Badges don't move him. Maybe something from the Blue Note would.

5898f8749b69.speaker: ray
5898f8749b69.text: Danny knocked on Sal's door. He must have knocked on this one too.

aa71aa686167.speaker: ray
aa71aa686167.text: Blue Note envelope. Singed at one corner, soaked through, but the back survived.

e729075c438e.speaker: ray
e729075c438e.text: One of three. One of three what?

8e21cf95e822.speaker: ray
8e21cf95e822.text: Sixties. Cardigan, reading glasses, shoulder holster. A grandfather who forecloses.

20b776a582c1.speaker: ray
20b776a582c1.text: Close range. A .38. Wallet left on him.

8de7613e003c.speaker: ray
8de7613e003c.text: IOUs. Dozens of them, pinned in rows like butterflies.

f8868703c183.speaker: ray
f8868703c183.text: Reyes, D. $8,000. Stamped PAID in red, dated Tuesday.

dee042085243.speaker: ray
dee042085243.text: Danny's is the only one stamped PAID. The only one.

27d21b909874.speaker: ray
27d21b909874.text: A Colt .45 on the blotter, next to a cup of tea. A man of contrasts.

8b00c0a82267.speaker: ray
8b00c0a82267.text: Touching a loan shark's gun in his own office is the kind of thing they carve on your headstone.

42633041fafc.speaker: ray
42633041fafc.text: A green ledger. Vance's real business. He'd sooner give me a kidney.

7acb67e9eede.speaker: ray
7acb67e9eede.text: A sport fisher called Second Chance. Loan sharks all have the same sense of humor.

08210324e822.speaker: ray
08210324e822.text: Green banker's lamp. Same as mine. We buy from the same catalog, and that's all we share.

d23ae9169f86.speaker: ray
d23ae9169f86.text: No key under this one. I checked.

8ff6d69554dd.speaker: ray
8ff6d69554dd.text: Glowing orange. It's the warmest thing in the room, Vance included.

6f9005fadfb9.speaker: ray
6f9005fadfb9.text: Third row, fourth from the left. Reyes, D. Eight thousand. Stamped PAID, Tuesday's date.

6836fce14dee.speaker: ray
6836fce14dee.text: Eight grand. From a man who played for tips.

1b8a1c45771a.speaker: ray
1b8a1c45771a.text: Paid in full Tuesday afternoon. Dead by Tuesday midnight.

ec8d3bc3ef6c.speaker: ray
ec8d3bc3ef6c.text: Daniel 'Danny' Reyes, 34. Piano player at the Blue Note.

619408a3da63.speaker: ray
619408a3da63.text: Found in the alley next to the club, two nights ago. Wallet still on him.

5f8c0ea8a826.speaker: ray
5f8c0ea8a826.text: One shot, a .38, close enough to leave powder on his shirt.

f2ddac7deacf.speaker: ray
f2ddac7deacf.text: No phone. A musician without a phone. The uniforms looked everywhere but the right place.

de41c6f26f40.speaker: ray
de41c6f26f40.text: The bartender, Sal Moretti, told the uniforms he saw nothing.

b812679c6727.speaker: ray
b812679c6727.text: Sal sees everything. That's his job.

ff8d7a5d82ae.speaker: ray
ff8d7a5d82ae.text: A Blue Note envelope, empty, singed. On the back in Danny's hand: '1 of 3.'

333d3bed7fda.speaker: ray
333d3bed7fda.text: Whoever was paying Danny, they were on an installment plan.

f84fb9018324.speaker: ray
f84fb9018324.text: A small brass key. Opens the filing cabinet.

b4465377b3a5.speaker: ray
b4465377b3a5.text: Stone cold. Something rattles at the bottom of the mug.

8ce08b16c7fe.speaker: ray
8ce08b16c7fe.text: Ten cents. The price of a phone call in this town.

5b28a23f33fd.speaker: ray
5b28a23f33fd.text: Blue Note matches. Someone wrote a number inside: 555-0147.

74fa58b147a0.speaker: ray
74fa58b147a0.text: A boat hook. Six feet of pole and a bad attitude at the end.

cec3fff2ee0d.speaker: ray
cec3fff2ee0d.text: I can't do anything with that.

224250fea508.speaker: ray
224250fea508.text: We've said all there is to say.

6bec93b476b3.speaker: ray
6bec93b476b3.text: Nothing left to ask. Nothing I want the answer to, anyway.

48e8cad7dd07.speaker: ray
48e8cad7dd07.text: I've had all the answers I'm getting here.

8340eda2cbf5.speaker: ray
8340eda2cbf5.text: We've been over it. Twice would just be rude.

912ea1b8ffe6.speaker: ray
912ea1b8ffe6.text: I've got nothing new. I'll come back when I do.

46d9d4761c79.speaker: ray
46d9d4761c79.text: Asking again won't make the answers any better.

d9ba72b5318a.speaker: ray
d9ba72b5318a.text: Everything's been said. Some of it was even true.

c1bf57e9e9a1.speaker: ray
c1bf57e9e9a1.text: I know what I came to know.

bbb9b8ac0395.speaker: doyle
bbb9b8ac0395.text: *beep* Ray, it's Doyle. Eleven-forty. I've got the captain asking about Reyes.

b0774146c990.speaker: doyle
b0774146c990.text: It's a gambling debt and a .38 in an alley, it's not the Black Dahlia. Get me a name by Friday.

a28e10815493.speaker: doyle
a28e10815493.text: And answer your cell once in a while. *beep*

8831d64afdc7.speaker: doyle
8831d64afdc7.text: So the loan shark has a boat. Congratulations. Where'd you even get Vance?

c22a7cd8b776.speaker: doyle
c22a7cd8b776.text: Moretti told the uniforms he was blind and deaf.

5b26f4f38a8f.speaker: doyle
5b26f4f38a8f.text: Sorry. Ray, I have the captain on Friday and a dead piano player who paid his bills.

4d5000eb1ebc.speaker: doyle
4d5000eb1ebc.text: That's not a lead, that's a eulogy.

a14603aa373c.speaker: doyle
a14603aa373c.text: Then write it up. And stop wasting the night on one case. Otis has a stack. *click*

bf1e7c6378e2.speaker: nina
bf1e7c6378e2.text: Sal don't take calls. Who's asking?

2e09c29b92db.speaker: nina
2e09c29b92db.text: ...Danny was a good kid. Owed the wrong people.

e4f05eba53e1.speaker: nina
e4f05eba53e1.text: Nina. I wait tables at the Note. Waited.

922ac762465e.speaker: nina
922ac762465e.text: I was his girl. Whatever that means now.

65f78d7b6cbd.speaker: nina
65f78d7b6cbd.text: Then you're two days late, Ray Kessler.

22148b9c6555.speaker: nina
22148b9c6555.text: Friends of Danny knock like Danny played. Two slow, three fast.

59e9037eec98.speaker: nina
59e9037eec98.text: Sal's scared, Detective. Don't make me sorry I told you.

3e89b88c24f2.speaker: sal
3e89b88c24f2.text: Cops don't know that knock. Somebody gave it to you.

198fe94e9ae6.speaker: sal
198fe94e9ae6.text: Door stays shut. Talk through it.

bdf4bb7faf39.speaker: sal
bdf4bb7faf39.text: Danny didn't have friends. He had a piano and a tab.

bb2849ec5d4b.speaker: sal
bb2849ec5d4b.text: I was counting the till. One shot. When I looked out the back, there was only Danny and the rain.

a1da25c9ce95.speaker: sal
a1da25c9ce95.text: I told the uniforms what they wanted to write down.

664c54b9f674.speaker: sal
664c54b9f674.text: A man named Vance. Vance doesn't send letters, if you follow me.

75627df2e153.speaker: sal
75627df2e153.text: Pier 9. Warehouse with the green door.

7a25f4cfcfd4.speaker: sal
7a25f4cfcfd4.text: Three people alive know that knock now. Her, me, and you. Keep it that way.

59ccc44aa855.speaker: sal
59ccc44aa855.text: And you didn't hear it from me. You never heard me at all.

93739503432b.speaker: tiny
93739503432b.text: Knock on that door and you'll be knocking with your teeth.

a29969a68575.speaker: tiny
a29969a68575.text: Bring that back when you're done.

bde9f6aa3af8.speaker: tiny
bde9f6aa3af8.text: You find who did Danny, you come tell me.

00651987e88a.speaker: tiny
00651987e88a.text: Boat hook's on the piling. Bring it back after.

9467a9195b86.speaker: tiny
9467a9195b86.text: Mr. Vance doesn't see people at night. Mr. Vance doesn't see people in the day, either.

a57f9a08b96d.speaker: tiny
a57f9a08b96d.text: A badge gets you a lawyer, not a door. Come back with paper.

fc52ba1a618d.speaker: tiny
fc52ba1a618d.text: KJAZZ. Only station that still plays piano after midnight.

536f11c7c55f.speaker: tiny
536f11c7c55f.text: Used to be I didn't need a radio for that.

33e8e44d10cc.speaker: tiny
33e8e44d10cc.text: Thursdays. Kid used to play 'Round Midnight' for me without me asking.

767882fad012.speaker: tiny
767882fad012.text: Danny. Somebody put him down in that alley like a dog.

613fb7dab53c.speaker: tiny
613fb7dab53c.text: Still can't let you in. Mr. Vance only opens up for people who've been here before.

d4c3cc0d54b7.speaker: tiny
d4c3cc0d54b7.text: ...That's Danny's knock. He came every Tuesday to pay.

daee02efb80e.speaker: tiny
daee02efb80e.text: Knocked like that every time, like he was playing it.

cb1a259abdb6.speaker: tiny
cb1a259abdb6.text: Detective. You find who did Danny, you come tell me. I want to hear it from somebody.

baabe9f550a6.speaker: vance
baabe9f550a6.text: Detective. Tiny tells me you're a friend of Danny's. Tiny is sentimental. I'm not.

e544a1acebed.speaker: vance
e544a1acebed.text: Sit, if you like. The chair is uncomfortable. I bought it that way.

909b901e6495.speaker: vance
909b901e6495.text: If I'd had him shot, they'd have taken the wallet. It saves my people the trouble of sending flowers.

833eef17d610.speaker: vance
833eef17d610.text: Was it? Interesting. Not to me.

c05864332421.speaker: vance
c05864332421.text: Look at my wall, Detective. I keep better records than your department.

4cb796b3ff6f.speaker: vance
4cb796b3ff6f.text: That's it. One of three. Sounds like a man with a payment plan.

9dd56ee96f20.speaker: vance
9dd56ee96f20.text: Half this city owes me money, Detective. The other half owes the bank. I'm friendlier.

da8c11a9b152.speaker: vance
da8c11a9b152.text: I read the papers. Dead men are bad for business. Think about that.

ea4c823ddfc0.speaker: vance
ea4c823ddfc0.text: On my boat in Avalon harbor. I lost four hundred dollars at cards to a dentist from Torrance.

4f29115728bd.speaker: vance
4f29115728bd.text: Harbor patrol logged me in at six and out Wednesday at noon. Check it.

1cdc0c2ad5e1.speaker: vance
1cdc0c2ad5e1.text: I know. That's why I told you.

710d1355e986.speaker: vance
710d1355e986.text: It is. Your piano player was shot with a .38, if the Times is right.

66618bd2bf77.speaker: vance
66618bd2bf77.text: I've never owned a revolver. They're for people who want to be romantic about it.

95b5237119c1.speaker: vance
95b5237119c1.text: Dead men don't pay, Detective. Danny paid. All of it, Tuesday afternoon, in cash.

a8139503d68c.speaker: vance
a8139503d68c.text: I asked him the same thing. He smiled, which was new.

e3dd9f4e2792.speaker: vance
e3dd9f4e2792.text: Said he'd come into some money and there was more where it came from.

ae5d4213d583.speaker: vance
ae5d4213d583.text: I don't ask where money comes from. Only where it's going.

3abd7da43f43.speaker: vance
3abd7da43f43.text: In a Blue Note envelope, like a boy bringing his allowance.

581f34483675.speaker: vance
581f34483675.text: He'd written something on the back. I didn't read it. I'm not his diary.

bc6ee949c174.speaker: vance
bc6ee949c174.text: Tiny burns the trash every night. If it's anywhere, it's in the barrel.

83fffd24eb0e.speaker: vance
83fffd24eb0e.text: You're the second this week. Yesterday a man telephoned.

1323b87c4743.speaker: vance
1323b87c4743.text: Wanted to know if Danny had paid me, and in what.

2e19f71abe1c.speaker: vance
2e19f71abe1c.text: He didn't offer one. He talked like a cop who'd stopped being one.

2504dc8e0cf9.speaker: vance
2504dc8e0cf9.text: You'd know the type better than I would.

a7d720c3606f.speaker: vance
a7d720c3606f.text: What I'm telling you. Less, actually. I liked his voice less.

42e1eed2676a.speaker: vance
42e1eed2676a.text: Detective. Whoever did Danny, it wasn't for my eight thousand. He'd already paid it.

3ddf76780dfe.speaker: vance
3ddf76780dfe.text: Find out who he was expecting to pay him.

be86d4493ebc.speaker: vance
be86d4493ebc.text: Tiny will see you out. Come back when you've got a better question.

370f57c1c4ad.speaker: otis
370f57c1c4ad.text: Ray, it's Otis. Hope I'm not interrupting your social life.

0a1e01295857.speaker: otis
0a1e01295857.text: Danny'll keep. I've got a rideshare driver dead behind the wheel up at the Mulholland overlook.

dd3648a7cfe1.speaker: otis
dd3648a7cfe1.text: Engine still running. Patrol's holding it for you.

cf6c54122b68.speaker: otis
cf6c54122b68.text: Bring a coat. It's windy up there.

ed93e9d49acf.speaker: devin
ed93e9d49acf.text: Yeah. He's driving. He drives nights. Why?

1e17b56070a3.speaker: ray
1e17b56070a3.text: Mulholland Drive. Twenty miles of curves along the top of the hills, so the rich can look down on the rest of us.

37d949e00b14.speaker: ray
37d949e00b14.text: Up here the rain comes in sideways. Down there, four million people are asleep, or wish they were.

13cd84e6b3d6.speaker: ray
13cd84e6b3d6.text: Glide says his night ended at eleven fifty-two. I'd like a second opinion. Cars talk too, these days.

0cc45e9b59ae.speaker: ray
0cc45e9b59ae.text: Norm's. Cherry pie, two coffees, twelve-fourteen.

841191afb8c5.speaker: ray
841191afb8c5.text: Home, Silver Lake. Two minutes, eleven fifty-six. Somebody was waiting.

b07809ed4d82.speaker: ray
b07809ed4d82.text: Detective Kessler, LAPD. Does Kenji Ota live here?

15de4a3c88d5.speaker: ray
15de4a3c88d5.text: Twenty-nine years old, four point nine eight stars. The man who killed him was the only one who knew he wasn't coming home.

d54efe3d22a9.speaker: devin
d54efe3d22a9.text: No. No, no. What happened? Was it a crash?

c88b9b562267.speaker: devin
c88b9b562267.text: Jesus. Who would... He's a Glide driver. He gives people water bottles.

e996e5d753a4.speaker: devin
e996e5d753a4.text: Search. Go ahead. You won't find anything.

f7b69ef2c979.speaker: devin
f7b69ef2c979.text: Devin. Devin Clark. Roommate, three years. I'm a photographer. Weddings, headshots, whatever pays.

ed764d18cbac.speaker: devin
ed764d18cbac.text: Dinner. Like six? Then he went out for his shift. I've been home all night, editing. I was asleep by eleven.

db144c7c46d9.speaker: devin
db144c7c46d9.text: I just got up and had a shower, I couldn't sleep.

179eeadf6e21.speaker: devin
179eeadf6e21.text: Both. You know what I mean.

67b522f2399a.speaker: devin
67b522f2399a.text: There's this driver, Heck something. He keyed Kenji's car. And riders, people get crazy in the back seat. You should ask Glide.

a4b038ed1692.speaker: devin
a4b038ed1692.text: Kenji's room, sure. Whatever helps. Mine's a mess. And I'm not okay with you going through my stuff, you know?

3a5cb82bb958.speaker: devin
3a5cb82bb958.text: Okay. Okay, I went out. I knew how it would look. We got pie.

996fa087008a.speaker: devin
996fa087008a.text: He dropped me back here at like twelve-forty and drove off. That's the last time I saw him. I swear to God.

a7c3a15fa242.speaker: devin
a7c3a15fa242.text: You want to search? Search. Search the whole place. You won't find anything, because there's nothing to find.

990e76ca3872.speaker: devin
990e76ca3872.text: Those are mine. Half of those are mine. A year of work, and he was going to give them away.

2df78b4c0de1.speaker: devin
2df78b4c0de1.text: Give them away, to some assistant who got what she...

e3806a4b3c56.speaker: park
e3806a4b3c56.text: I was taking the Ota car down the hill. Silver Lake was on the way.

f3b477c391be.speaker: park
f3b477c391be.text: Devin Clark? Stand up for me.

f9343a845641.speaker: ray
f9343a845641.text: I'm sorry. Kenji was found dead tonight, in his car, up on Mulholland.

481820780791.speaker: ray
481820780791.text: Not here. Whatever's in that bag, I'll open it over the sink.

343fe87bb6b4.speaker: ray
343fe87bb6b4.text: Wet hair at two in the morning. Grief takes a lot of shapes. So does a shower.

c50876b49eec.speaker: ray
c50876b49eec.text: He hasn't moved off that fridge since I came in.

b4f359802e49.speaker: ray
b4f359802e49.text: Let him tell me his story first. Then I'll show him mine.

699db887f272.speaker: ray
699db887f272.text: He's seen enough tonight. So have I.

626905a72133.speaker: ray
626905a72133.text: A printout from HushHush: "STUDIO ASSISTANT'S BACK-SEAT MELTDOWN". The photo's from a dashcam, looking at the back seat.

9103c2a4a880.speaker: ray
9103c2a4a880.text: A sticky note in Kenji's hand: "Carla Mendes. Fired over this. My fault. Giving her lawyer the cards. Done with HH."

a3d62a77fa7b.speaker: ray
a3d62a77fa7b.text: So the camera wasn't for safety.

3028695ea379.speaker: ray
3028695ea379.text: An empty box on Kenji's shelf. DuoCam 2: road and cabin. Memory cards sold separately.

c9dfe4481ac4.speaker: ray
c9dfe4481ac4.text: GLIDE DRIVER OF THE MONTH. Five stars, every ride, for thirty days. I've never managed thirty minutes.

acbec01d71b1.speaker: ray
acbec01d71b1.text: A black camera bag on the hook. An inch wide, woven herringbone. Shah would want to meet this strap.

4a4a46257922.speaker: ray
4a4a46257922.text: A black camera bag on the hook. The strap's an inch wide.

dd409c959b01.speaker: ray
dd409c959b01.text: His bag, and he's watching me look at it. Not without paper.

92f099b82394.speaker: ray
92f099b82394.text: Running shoes, soaked through. Pale orange grit in the treads. Decomposed granite, same as the overlook lot.

865f325ff8d3.speaker: ray
865f325ff8d3.text: Running shoes, soaked through. Grit in the treads.

d7980f3a5747.speaker: ray
d7980f3a5747.text: I'll let the lab pick his shoes.

0045cb0e03db.speaker: ray
0045cb0e03db.text: Open to a photo editor. A folder called WEDDINGS_OCT. Last saved at 6:12 p.m.

7318779b9e9e.speaker: ray
7318779b9e9e.text: Editing all night, and the last save was before dinner.

464bed52a947.speaker: ray
464bed52a947.text: Night shots of LA. Good ones. Freeway ramps, the Bowl, and the Mulholland overlook, from exactly where Kenji's car is parked.

e1daaa00a6c5.speaker: ray
e1daaa00a6c5.text: Devin's leaning on that fridge like it owes him rent.

bef5edd4b224.speaker: ray
bef5edd4b224.text: Magnets, takeout menus, and a note in Kenji's hand.

5bd20e92db44.speaker: ray
5bd20e92db44.text: "D, your peas have been in here since July. Eat them or I'm tossing them. K."

b9b7ff5d4eda.speaker: ray
b9b7ff5d4eda.text: Ice and vodka. I'm on duty.

d82d50360ebe.speaker: ray
d82d50360ebe.text: Fresh finger marks in the frost, and a puddle under the door. Somebody opened this tonight with wet hands.

b43bc7926446.speaker: ray
b43bc7926446.text: A steel sink under the kitchen window. Clean. Cleaner than the rest of the place.

af04bae8b373.speaker: ray
af04bae8b373.text: Good place to open a bag of peas.

d180d21a4961.speaker: ray
d180d21a4961.text: I'm not here to do the dishes.

2945e8f6d5ef.speaker: ray
2945e8f6d5ef.text: A big TV, switched off. A dark screen's easier to look at than a cop.

421865c0df20.speaker: ray
421865c0df20.text: I didn't come here to watch anything.

4865f75d85be.speaker: ray
4865f75d85be.text: Two plates and a takeout box. Dinner at six, Devin said. That part might even be true.

05c36290cd75.speaker: ray
05c36290cd75.text: Closed. His room, his rules, until I've got paper.

6ceded204cef.speaker: ray
6ceded204cef.text: Not now. Devin said search, and I haven't finished searching.

df571344daa1.speaker: ray
df571344daa1.text: He couldn't get off that fridge fast enough once I said search. Before that, he couldn't get off it at all.

a22e6cf8dc27.speaker: ray
a22e6cf8dc27.text: Asleep by eleven and editing all night.

2b34c4e55976.speaker: ray
2b34c4e55976.text: He says he was home. Norm's might say different.

3d8cd53c9289.speaker: ray
3d8cd53c9289.text: Norm's on Sunset. Table six, twelve-fourteen. Two coffees, one cherry pie. Signed D. Clark.

e31c1be9e409.speaker: ray
e31c1be9e409.text: A waitress at Norm's puts Kenji in booth six at midnight with his roommate. The one with the camera bag.

71f204bfbb92.speaker: ray
71f204bfbb92.text: You told me you were asleep by eleven.

dab3ac444743.speaker: ray
dab3ac444743.text: He's got a new story. Kenji's car will have an opinion about it.

fec56d8c38ba.speaker: ray
fec56d8c38ba.text: Kenji's car keeps a diary. Home at eleven fifty-six, two minutes. Norm's at eight past twelve. Then straight up Mulholland.

0ec128c6eaa1.speaker: ray
0ec128c6eaa1.text: It never came back here, Devin.

6f69ee3162d1.speaker: ray
6f69ee3162d1.text: So how did you get home?

11825bad207a.speaker: ray
11825bad207a.text: A couple driving up passed a man walking down Mulholland at one-fifteen. Hood up. Carrying a bag.

c79595321005.speaker: ray
c79595321005.text: And your shoes are full of that overlook.

a1799d394f87.speaker: ray
a1799d394f87.text: Off the fridge, and onto the couch. Staring at a TV that isn't on.

95874dc98f9d.speaker: ray
95874dc98f9d.text: Ice trays, a bottle of vodka, and a bag of frozen peas taped shut. Nobody tapes peas.

8b2f138cd7d3.speaker: ray
8b2f138cd7d3.text: Peas rattle into the sink. Underneath, a zip bag.

ab594134968b.speaker: ray
ab594134968b.text: A two-lens dashcam, and a clear plastic case of memory cards, labeled in Kenji's handwriting. January to November.

1dfca6d44da3.speaker: ray
1dfca6d44da3.text: Nobody ever got killed over frozen peas.

147f094dd348.speaker: ray
147f094dd348.text: Park, it's Kessler. Silver Lake. Come up the stairs.

894db7469ff7.speaker: ray
894db7469ff7.text: No. That one stays. The strap's going to meet Dr. Shah.

2df2fb549127.speaker: ray
2df2fb549127.text: Eleven cards. Twenty-five hundred apiece. Twenty-seven thousand dollars, and a man who wanted to give it back.

416989349eb2.speaker: brielle
416989349eb2.text: My Glide driver has a camera pointed at the back seat? Like, at me?

8ee0c7495cc7.speaker: park
8ee0c7495cc7.text: Detective Kessler? Officer Park. Lena. I've held the scene since one twenty-two. Nobody's touched the car but Dr. Shah.

98705a160ba2.speaker: park
98705a160ba2.text: A couple came up to, uh, look at the view. Engine running, wipers going, nobody moving. I took their statement and let them go home.

3ca512fd2f2a.speaker: park
3ca512fd2f2a.text: Kenji Ota, twenty-nine, Silver Lake address. Drives for Glide. Four point nine eight stars, which is higher than my mom.

8b0427486316.speaker: park
8b0427486316.text: Wallet in his jacket, phone in the dash mount. The dashcam mount's empty.

07321e596f88.speaker: park
07321e596f88.text: The app says a Brielle V., dropped in Silver Lake at eleven fifty-two. I looked her up. She's, kind of famous?

1476a2be5de9.speaker: park
1476a2be5de9.text: She posted this at eleven fifty-eight.

9c1d23f868e0.speaker: park
9c1d23f868e0.text: And she's been live since twelve-twenty. Hot tub, Hollywood Hills, thirty-one thousand people watching. She's doing karaoke now.

921d75fde005.speaker: park
921d75fde005.text: Driving up, around one-fifteen, they passed a guy walking down Mulholland. Hood up, carrying a bag. No car anywhere.

02a2e08152a9.speaker: park
02a2e08152a9.text: They figured he was a hiker.

a60829b818cc.speaker: park
a60829b818cc.text: I'll be at the tape, Detective.

d10d02eb08ba.speaker: park
d10d02eb08ba.text: I'll ride down with the car. Call if you need a unit, Detective. I'll be in the neighborhood all night.

4ac71be8c9da.speaker: ray
4ac71be8c9da.text: The overlook. Best view in Los Angeles. He had it all to himself, and he isn't looking.

918635d1e4e2.speaker: ray
918635d1e4e2.text: Kenji Ota. Twenty-nine. His hands are still on the wheel, like he was about to go somewhere.

d0552fe845fd.speaker: ray
d0552fe845fd.text: Shah's already done everything I'd do, and better.

69fd4726b6e1.speaker: ray
69fd4726b6e1.text: Dr. Anita Shah, coroner's investigator. She can read a body like I read a liar.

6dc1dd461801.speaker: ray
6dc1dd461801.text: Officer Park. Rain cape, notebook, the kind of thorough they train out of you by year three.

87f0a02a8a52.speaker: ray
87f0a02a8a52.text: She's holding the tape, not the evidence.

2b631ac8934d.speaker: ray
2b631ac8934d.text: The driver's door is open. The dome light's on, and Kenji's still at the wheel.

b784395f3189.speaker: ray
b784395f3189.text: A white Prius. Half the cars in LA are white Priuses, and the other half are waiting for one.

32263325a2f2.speaker: ray
32263325a2f2.text: He kept it clean, inside and out. Except for the back door.

2b80d95e77b8.speaker: ray
2b80d95e77b8.text: Engine running, wipers going. The car hasn't heard the news.

0e897a72cc74.speaker: ray
0e897a72cc74.text: Somebody keyed RAT into the back door. Big letters, right through the white.

dfbbb3be5785.speaker: ray
dfbbb3be5785.text: Weeks-old rust. Whoever wrote it wasn't up here tonight. Or wasn't up here with a key.

86c26d5a6465.speaker: ray
86c26d5a6465.text: There's rust in the scratches. Weeks old. Not tonight's work.

461f7e8b44c5.speaker: ray
461f7e8b44c5.text: But somebody thought Kenji was a rat, and wanted every rider to see it.

d236fbe1c312.speaker: ray
d236fbe1c312.text: Pale orange grit, the decomposed granite they pave these lots with. It gets into everything.

2bb31bf5dffe.speaker: ray
2bb31bf5dffe.text: I'm not throwing evidence off Mulholland.

ab17e1e8559d.speaker: ray
ab17e1e8559d.text: Four million lights. From up here you can't tell which ones are on fire.

2fa95f2a54fb.speaker: ray
2fa95f2a54fb.text: It's a long way down. Kenji went the slow way.

4be85c4c6c3f.speaker: ray
4be85c4c6c3f.text: Shah's van. It'll take him down the hill the slow way.

a680ca5c2f6b.speaker: ray
a680ca5c2f6b.text: MULHOLLAND SCENIC OVERLOOK. Open sunrise to sunset. Somebody came up after hours.

3e660080c8bf.speaker: ray
3e660080c8bf.text: My car. Rain's getting in the dents.

bc6a62d0d311.speaker: ray
bc6a62d0d311.text: Wallet left on the body. I've seen that one this week.

84f8f7969efa.speaker: ray
84f8f7969efa.text: Thirty-one thousand witnesses. Best alibi I've ever seen, and I hated every second of it.

503567d27efe.speaker: ray
503567d27efe.text: Walking. On Mulholland. At one in the morning, in the rain.

a8cf21468bc2.speaker: ray
a8cf21468bc2.text: Somebody he let sit behind him.

05a69ee8f82c.speaker: ray
05a69ee8f82c.text: Last meal, cherry pie. Somebody should put that on a menu.

7d637032084a.speaker: ray
7d637032084a.text: Shah's going to want a word. Shah always wants a word.

ed8c8c41cd08.speaker: ray
ed8c8c41cd08.text: Not yet. Kenji's car still has things to tell me.

c172299b891d.speaker: shah
c172299b891d.text: I know who he is, Ray. I'd like to know who did it.

7d780e9f06a1.speaker: shah
7d780e9f06a1.text: Ray. Gloves before you touch anything. I mean it this time.

4074d9a0ec75.speaker: shah
4074d9a0ec75.text: Strangled. Not by hand. A ligature, flat, about an inch wide. See the bruise? It has a pattern. A woven herringbone, like a strap.

617ca16eb4b4.speaker: shah
617ca16eb4b4.text: Pulled from behind and a little to the right. Whoever did it was in the back seat on the passenger side, or leaning between the seats.

ab3b23e75b55.speaker: shah
ab3b23e75b55.text: No defensive wounds to speak of. He didn't see it coming. You don't, from someone you know.

2ff88837e3f8.speaker: shah
2ff88837e3f8.text: The heater's been blowing on him for an hour, which doesn't help me. Between one and one-fifteen.

c391061997b7.speaker: shah
c391061997b7.text: Two black nylon fibers under his collar. I'll know more at the lab. And there's cherry pie crust on his shirt.

1000aef826f7.speaker: shah
1000aef826f7.text: Don't thank me. Find who did it, and then don't thank me again.

c79fa0e47835.speaker: heck
c79fa0e47835.text: Yeah, that's him. Four point nine eight. Show-off.

79621cbc2db4.speaker: heck
79621cbc2db4.text: If you're a rider, I'm on break. If you're a cop, I'm on break harder.

1b8b66dd3768.speaker: heck
1b8b66dd3768.text: The queue jumper? What'd he do, cut in line at the Pearly Gates?

c0db42239d21.speaker: heck
c0db42239d21.text: No. No, man. I yelled at him. I didn't, I would never.

20f0c20fa975.speaker: heck
20f0c20fa975.text: It's an expression! You never said something in traffic?

e09e5b5cd865.speaker: heck
e09e5b5cd865.text: Everybody knew he had a camera looking at the back seat. "For safety." Then he's got new tires and a new phone on what Glide pays?

3922d257bcd8.speaker: heck
3922d257bcd8.text: Last week he told me he was quitting the side thing. Said it got somebody hurt.

58754f27572c.speaker: heck
58754f27572c.text: The photographer? Rode along sometimes, in the back like a passenger, filming out the window.

45f36c6686a5.speaker: heck
45f36c6686a5.text: Kenji called it "B-roll". Whatever that is.

58c334224b2b.speaker: heck
58c334224b2b.text: Hey. Detective. I'm sorry, okay? About the ground thing.

caab8029c41e.speaker: heck
caab8029c41e.text: The LAX lot. Eleven to one-forty, sitting in the queue like a good boy. Look.

0ef457a52fff.speaker: heck
0ef457a52fff.text: And the lot's got four cameras. Check 'em.

ca401a99385e.speaker: ray
ca401a99385e.text: Norm's. Open twenty-four hours since 1957. The coffee's improved since then. Not by much.

aa4a4e63eca8.speaker: ray
aa4a4e63eca8.text: Rosa. Thirty years on this floor, and she's still faster than the cook.

dee5c5879dff.speaker: ray
dee5c5879dff.text: A full pot on the warmer.

37a83aa0bcb3.speaker: ray
37a83aa0bcb3.text: A full pot on the warmer. Rosa's got the other one, and six empty cups are waving at her.

523634e599da.speaker: ray
523634e599da.text: I've done my shift. Rosa's got it.

9437e9caf605.speaker: ray
9437e9caf605.text: Glide jacket, three phones in a row. Two driving apps and one for the horses.

406f642543b3.speaker: ray
406f642543b3.text: Booth six. Two cup rings, a plate with a cherry smear, and a napkin somebody did math on.

18b1dd44c6dc.speaker: ray
18b1dd44c6dc.text: "11 × 2,500." Under it, "50/50", crossed out so hard the pen went through.

2b7933317b8d.speaker: ray
2b7933317b8d.text: Twenty-seven thousand five hundred dollars of somebody's math. And somebody disagreed with it.

04be5ffdf72b.speaker: ray
04be5ffdf72b.text: Cherry, apple, and a lemon meringue that's seen things.

ce0d0d2f3e19.speaker: ray
ce0d0d2f3e19.text: I've got an appetite to protect.

c8ce3a9b5446.speaker: ray
c8ce3a9b5446.text: Cabbies, a nurse off a double, a guard asleep in his eggs. The night shift's congregation.

e63e1a71a433.speaker: ray
e63e1a71a433.text: Somebody put a quarter on Chet Baker.

4786e973e804.speaker: ray
4786e973e804.text: Rain on Sunset. A bus goes by with nobody on it.

add303ecaf23.speaker: ray
add303ecaf23.text: You're asleep, you don't need coffee. Coffee.

bea86090ea72.speaker: ray
bea86090ea72.text: I'm looking for a Glide driver. Kenji Ota.

2ade6d551010.speaker: ray
2ade6d551010.text: Faces. I've got one of those in my pocket.

420a9f713ed6.speaker: ray
420a9f713ed6.text: He was killed tonight, Rosa. Up on Mulholland.

a84fdc2de762.speaker: ray
a84fdc2de762.text: Somebody strangled him tonight. Up on Mulholland.

d5369786215b.speaker: ray
d5369786215b.text: Tuesday, six-oh-two p.m. "Do it once more and I'll put you in the ground."

07b42abe2f0c.speaker: ray
07b42abe2f0c.text: Where were you from midnight to one-thirty?

08fecd3e2176.speaker: ray
08fecd3e2176.text: Forty-one cars ahead of him at eleven. Nobody gets from LAX to Mulholland and back in that line.

3947601fa858.speaker: rosa
3947601fa858.text: Sit anywhere, hon. I'll get to you when I get to you.

24a800e8351c.speaker: rosa
24a800e8351c.text: Hold that thought, hon. Twelve cups, two hands, and Luis called in sick.

e57a8611b494.speaker: rosa
e57a8611b494.text: That's him, hon. I already told you. Booth six.

42c890e3128b.speaker: rosa
42c890e3128b.text: You've got the slip, hon. The receipt's all yours too.

d7926a66caff.speaker: rosa
d7926a66caff.text: Unless it's a tip, hon, I don't need it.

26dd392bb30a.speaker: rosa
26dd392bb30a.text: Well. A cop who pours. Now I've seen everything. Put that down before you get ideas, hon. What do you need?

1c6945bb3dc9.speaker: rosa
1c6945bb3dc9.text: Hon, I know faces, not names. Half my counter drives for somebody.

83c0b3a48953.speaker: rosa
83c0b3a48953.text: The roommate, for once. On a card. I noticed, because Kenji always pays.

26dbdbae06be.speaker: rosa
26dbdbae06be.text: Twenty to one, about. Together. The roommate carried that bag out like there was a baby in it.

00717a243e2f.speaker: rosa
00717a243e2f.text: I know the booth, hon. The drawer doesn't. Two hundred merchant copies, stacked by the minute they rang up.

34a7ae8cd2ab.speaker: rosa
34a7ae8cd2ab.text: "Around midnight" is forty of them. Bring me his check and I'll find it.

82c040b035f0.speaker: rosa
82c040b035f0.text: He tipped twenty percent on a two-dollar coffee, Detective. You get whoever did this.

19f1d9d8400e.speaker: rosa
19f1d9d8400e.text: Kenji. Sure. Coffee black, cherry pie à la mode, tips like a man who's waited tables.

e115aa28b2a1.speaker: rosa
e115aa28b2a1.text: He was in that booth two hours ago. Number six. I haven't even bussed it.

4015224bdb06.speaker: rosa
4015224bdb06.text: With his roommate. The one with the camera bag. Skinny, little beard, never says thank you. They come in after Kenji's shift sometimes.

a0aac54dc084.speaker: rosa
a0aac54dc084.text: Tonight they were going at it. Low, but going at it. Something about cards. The roommate kept saying "they're half mine." I figured baseball cards. Boys.

dbe37e36cd5c.speaker: rosa
dbe37e36cd5c.text: Table six, twelve-fourteen. We still take a signature here. Norm's is a historic landmark, and so's the card machine.

5019e215173b.speaker: rosa
5019e215173b.text: Here. Signed "D. Clark". Looks like a seismograph.

14c104ae85d5.speaker: ray
14c104ae85d5.text: His phone, still in the mount. The Glide app's open.

3eec03dd6008.speaker: ray
3eec03dd6008.text: The car's screen. Playing the radio to nobody.

df30bcb089f9.speaker: ray
df30bcb089f9.text: The car's screen. Dark, now the engine's off.

18d548bf1043.speaker: ray
18d548bf1043.text: A suction mount on the windshield, empty. The power cable's unplugged and coiled neat on the dash.

f2a69485b6ea.speaker: ray
f2a69485b6ea.text: Unscrewed, not ripped off. Both lenses gone, road and back seat. Somebody who knows cameras took their time.

16655a8479f6.speaker: ray
16655a8479f6.text: One black coffee, finished. One with cream, barely touched. Both cold.

2ffea214e383.speaker: ray
2ffea214e383.text: A door pocket full of mints and paper.

ac45bb3269a2.speaker: ray
ac45bb3269a2.text: A receipt from Norm's on Sunset. Table 6, twelve-fourteen.

65c25896a815.speaker: ray
65c25896a815.text: Mints. He cared about his rating.

4e732de046a6.speaker: ray
4e732de046a6.text: A card clipped to the visor.

d0ea6363212c.speaker: ray
d0ea6363212c.text: Just the visor. Kenji's card is in my pocket.

8965ddacb661.speaker: ray
8965ddacb661.text: Kenji's Glide card. Photo, plate number, four point nine eight stars.

b849638048c2.speaker: ray
b849638048c2.text: Just the visor now. And a mirror I'd rather not look in.

f5701333bff6.speaker: ray
f5701333bff6.text: Keys in the ignition. Engine running.

666d16c138c7.speaker: ray
666d16c138c7.text: Kill the engine and the screen dies with it. Read it first.

1ac606d5f230.speaker: ray
1ac606d5f230.text: Engine off. The wipers stop halfway across the glass. First quiet this car's had all night.

20c73d109c9d.speaker: ray
20c73d109c9d.text: Locked. A Prius driver who locks his glovebox has something worth more than napkins.

d8e057bd5e7a.speaker: ray
d8e057bd5e7a.text: Registration, insurance, a phone charger. And a little plastic case with twelve slots, labeled by month, January to December.

16b888428d09.speaker: ray
16b888428d09.text: Twelve slots for memory cards. Somebody emptied a year.

9f26e3572f8a.speaker: ray
9f26e3572f8a.text: Back seat, passenger side. The seat belt's still buckled, and the floor mat's scuffed like somebody braced his feet.

340c6ca35ec4.speaker: ray
340c6ca35ec4.text: Whoever sat here wasn't a paying customer.

6ea3ef797b18.speaker: ray
6ea3ef797b18.text: Shah will have my hands off at the wrist.

8cfee401de42.speaker: ray
8cfee401de42.text: The phone's locked behind the app. Glide lets me in. His personal life stays private, for now.

b788e9287fa6.speaker: ray
b788e9287fa6.text: His last fare ended at eleven fifty-two. After that, the app says he went home to bed.

027e00a4f717.speaker: ray
027e00a4f717.text: Heck D. Some people take the airport very seriously.

2ef44ddcf9cb.speaker: ray
2ef44ddcf9cb.text: Brielle V. Rider rated you one star: "camera??"

1b4cc433051a.speaker: ray
1b4cc433051a.text: Blue Note. Two nights ago. Huh.

5d0cf5cd4fc1.speaker: ray
5d0cf5cd4fc1.text: Dark. The keys are in my pocket.

2def324de210.speaker: ray
2def324de210.text: The car keeps its own diary. Home at eleven fifty-six, for two minutes. Norm's at eight past twelve. Then up here.

3e60997d43a3.speaker: ray
3e60997d43a3.text: Home: Silver Lake. I can read an address without the car driving me there.

c5d9a75d427f.speaker: ray
c5d9a75d427f.text: I know where I'm going. Mostly.

2e183375a331.speaker: ray
2e183375a331.text: The app says his night ended at eleven fifty-two. The car says it didn't. He went home for two minutes, then out for pie, then up here. Off the clock.

1aeaf79d3e84.speaker: ray
1aeaf79d3e84.text: Nobody drives a stranger around for free. He picked someone up at home.

682f3fbfd8db.speaker: ray
682f3fbfd8db.text: Can I see the card slip?

86e5d9ec748a.speaker: ray
86e5d9ec748a.text: When did you last see Kenji?

2ec26e22afff.speaker: ray
2ec26e22afff.text: His car never came back here.

7554e8b9adab.speaker: ray
7554e8b9adab.text: An LAX run. Forty minutes of brake lights for thirty-one dollars.

c5696e554015.speaker: ray
c5696e554015.text: A nurse to Cedars. Nurses tip in kindness.

9caab48aa3c0.speaker: ray
9caab48aa3c0.text: A bachelorette party. Six riders, five stars, and somebody's tiara in the back seat, I'd bet.

a47c3268745d.speaker: ray
a47c3268745d.text: Room 214. Danny's still in the middle of the board. Kenji gets a corner.

c058d7996166.speaker: ray
c058d7996166.text: Not yet. Kenji's waiting on the board.

ca749c89c41f.speaker: ray
ca749c89c41f.text: Two-forty. Two cases down, if you count one that won't close.

f38ded1a6366.speaker: ray
f38ded1a6366.text: Danny in the middle, Kenji in the corner. The board's getting crowded.

f9be447c08ac.speaker: ray
f9be447c08ac.text: Four point nine eight stars, and somebody gave him a zero. Who?

18c17b62f85a.speaker: ray
18c17b62f85a.text: Thirty-one thousand people watched her sing in a hot tub from twelve-twenty on. That's an alibi with a comment section.

8eff1f8ecc17.speaker: ray
8eff1f8ecc17.text: Heck was in the LAX lot with a hundred drivers and four cameras.

d79f8bf66ad1.speaker: ray
d79f8bf66ad1.text: Heck talks big. I never checked where he was, and the board wants proof, not a grudge.

f31782b20392.speaker: ray
f31782b20392.text: Off the app, home for two minutes, then pie? That's not a stranger. That's a friend.

b0071e884398.speaker: ray
b0071e884398.text: The one with the camera bag.

3d6110ae93f7.speaker: ray
3d6110ae93f7.text: Think, Ray. Who sat with Kenji at midnight, and what did he carry home?

2f03337b1433.speaker: ray
2f03337b1433.text: Devin Clark. Kenji wanted to give it back, and Devin wanted his half.

31423ab32b16.speaker: ray
31423ab32b16.text: The roommate. He's in a cell asking for a lawyer.

9201523836e2.speaker: ray
9201523836e2.text: It's not night anymore. It's not morning yet, either. That's my shift.

32dc7d0b926e.speaker: ray
32dc7d0b926e.text: Everybody in this town wants one.

b9068f498239.speaker: doyle
b9068f498239.text: Ray. Otis says you closed the rideshare in an hour.

89f4d3f200b5.speaker: doyle
89f4d3f200b5.text: See? That's what closing feels like. Try it on Reyes.

af9f3a05c19c.speaker: otis
af9f3a05c19c.text: Hollywood Boulevard. Stardust Memorabilia, across from the Chinese Theatre.

31a3a73f4531.speaker: otis
31a3a73f4531.text: Owner's at the bottom of the stairs to his own roof. Gus Lindqvist, seventy-one. And his Oscar's gone.

a76eb201a318.speaker: otis
a76eb201a318.text: Nineteen fifty-four, Best Supporting Actor. Not his, he bought it. Patrol thinks somebody came for the statue.

9786a8f9c88d.speaker: ray
9786a8f9c88d.text: That puts him at Norm's. What did he kill for?

380d1cb9ce7e.speaker: ray
380d1cb9ce7e.text: That's what he took. First, who sat with Kenji?

b77132348643.speaker: ray
b77132348643.text: Half the photographers in LA own that strap. Put him in the car first.

15dd373ef1c2.speaker: ray
15dd373ef1c2.text: That's a man walking home. Show me him sitting down with Kenji.

2f226c6232e3.speaker: ray
2f226c6232e3.text: Two coffees and a pie. Which two people?

ab2d64c7a20b.speaker: ray
ab2d64c7a20b.text: Kenji drove someone he knew. Which someone?

780457fdb254.speaker: ray
780457fdb254.text: That's why Kenji wanted out. What did Devin take home?

ad3fe9ec3570.speaker: ray
ad3fe9ec3570.text: Math on a napkin. Where's the thing the math was about?

27fe190ab945.speaker: ray
27fe190ab945.text: An empty case. Where did the cards end up?

437e97591de8.speaker: ray
437e97591de8.text: That's how. I need who was there and why.

ec2960fefa89.speaker: ray
ec2960fefa89.text: That's when. The when's not in doubt.

617095a604b1.speaker: ray
617095a604b1.text: That's his story. I'm pinning the truth.

8ece4db1c8b4.speaker: ray
8ece4db1c8b4.text: That clears somebody. I'm here to catch somebody.

cfbcb19c2ed1.speaker: ray
cfbcb19c2ed1.text: Heck says things in traffic. Devin did things.

9e379d03d60d.speaker: ray
9e379d03d60d.text: That's Kenji. He's already on the board.

91d5d66e87fd.speaker: ray
91d5d66e87fd.text: That's Tuesday. A different night. Maybe a different case.

1dbcd7fa0df1.speaker: ray
1dbcd7fa0df1.text: Whatever's in there, I'll open it over the sink.

af11912600bf.speaker: ray
af11912600bf.text: My photo of Kenji's screen. Wednesday, 1:10 a.m. Blue Note, Hollywood, to Pryce Tower, Century City.

7e148ac038e1.speaker: ray
7e148ac038e1.text: Rider: Walt B. Billed to Pryce Development, on the business account. One star. "Wet, rude, smelled like gun oil."

1d1d04df1967.speaker: ray
1d1d04df1967.text: A receipt from Norm's on Sunset. Table 6, twelve-fourteen. Two coffees, one cherry pie.

4cd82176a273.speaker: ray
4cd82176a273.text: Kenji's key ring. The car, a house key, and a little plastic Dodgers bat.

2d1c3a9039b1.speaker: ray
2d1c3a9039b1.text: The merchant copy. Table six, 12:14 a.m. Signed "D. Clark". Looks like a seismograph.

c3877179a59f.speaker: ray
c3877179a59f.text: A bag of frozen peas, taped shut. Nobody tapes peas.

d2b78fc1b0a0.speaker: ray
d2b78fc1b0a0.text: A two-lens dashcam and eleven memory cards, January to November, labeled in Kenji's hand.
